title: Agent
description: Registration record for an agent under test: where it runs, where its traces live, the docs the harness shows, and the tasks a deterministic verifier can score. This is not a Trace and not a Run. Each task carries its own setup and verifier checks, and may carry an optional evalset. The evalset is user-supplied material for a later Grok judgment of that task's Run or Trace. It is not a verifier check and it does not write outcome.verifier. An optional otel object names an OpenTelemetry source. The importer does not call that endpoint and does not invent fault.labels or outcome.verifier. An optional otel_mock object names dual fixture sources and schema remap A for the shop demo. The library seed omits otel and otel_mock. The shop seed omits otel and may carry otel_mock. The reference shop agent is seeded with five tasks (T1–T5). T1 includes one evalset case; T2–T5 omit the field. The library desk agent is seeded with three tasks that use library checks and omit evalset. Other agents may register a different non-empty task list.

instance.description: Production or reference runtime. kind=reference is the in-repo shop agent. kind=external is a registrant-supplied endpoint. base_url is the agent runtime, not the mock shop.

test_instance.description: Isolated runtime used for replays. Separate from instance so a fix replay does not hit the production endpoint.

path_or_url.description: Filesystem path, URL, or logical name when store is inline.

world.description: Inspectable mock for this agent. kind shop is the mock shop; kind library is the library mock. base_url is the mock, not the agent runtime. The harness calls MOCK_SHOP_URL for a shop world and world.base_url for a library world.

otel.description: Optional OpenTelemetry source registered on this agent. endpoint is the OTLP HTTP traces URL the operator documents. The lab importer does not dial it. auth.token_env names an environment variable; the token is not stored in this document. Omit the object when the agent has no OTel source. Import of spans is a separate batch (otel-import.schema.json) and still requires an explicit outcome.verifier.

version.description: OTel source document shape. Only 1 is valid in this contract.

endpoint.description: OTLP HTTP traces URL, for example https://otel.example.com/v1/traces. Not called by the importer.

token_env.description: Environment variable that holds the bearer token. Required when type is bearer, and forbidden when type is none. Must be an env-var name, not the token. The conditional is enforced by validateAgent.

service_name.description: When set, each imported item's service_name must equal this resource attribute. Omit to accept any service name on the batch.

otel_mock.description: Optional dual fixture sources and schema remap A for reference-shop. mode is fixture. The lab does not dial endpoint. fixture_path is the file readShopOtelMock loads. schema_id is mesa.otel.shop.a. Library mapping B is a different id and is not stored here.

endpoint.description: Documented URL. readShopOtelMock does not call it. Use a fixtures.invalid host for mock mode.

setup.description: World the harness builds before the agent runs, and the permissions granted on the agent request. Cart lines are added first. Each order then checks out that cart. permissions is the agent grant, not the header used to seed the shop.

from_cart.description: Check out the cart seeded above. The shop assigns the order id.

library.description: Loans the harness seeds on the library mock before the agent runs. Shop tasks omit this. Cart and orders stay empty.

type.description: Only verifier_checks in this freeze. The verifier reads mock state; it does not score the agent's prose.

name.description: Registered check type. Params are validated against that type's schema.

params.description: Arguments for this check type. Required keys depend on name. Unknown keys are rejected.

evalset.description: Optional user-supplied material a later Grok judgment may read when looking at a Run or Trace for this task. Omit the field when the task has none. version 1 with cases: [] is valid and means no cases yet. The deterministic verifier does not read this object. Pass/fail stays on success_test, scored from mock world state. This object never writes outcome.verifier. version is the shape of this object; only 1 is valid.

version.description: Evalset document shape. Only 1 is valid in this contract. A consumer that does not know the version must reject the document.

cases.description: Judge cases for this task. Order is the author's order. An empty array is valid.

case_id.description: Stable id within this task's evalset. Unique among cases on the same task.

expectation.description: What the judge should look for in the Trace or Run (claims, steps, tool use). Not a world-state assertion. Those stay on success_test.checks.

rubric.description: How the judge should score the expectation. Free text. Optional. Does not write outcome.verifier.
